messages.subject: Mentors please apply at melange
parts:
Dear Mentors,

google has their new version of melange online now, and mentors can
again apply.

At http://www.google-melange.com/gsoc/org/google/gsoc2011/rproject
you should see
mentors: apply!
with a Request button.

Our mentor list at the moment has:
Claudia Beleites
Hadley Wickham
John C Nash
Ravi Varadhan
Antony Unwin
Dianne Cook

so everyone else needs to sign up.

You need to have a melange account first.

Claudia

messages.author: 7a5c2ea68524e713
messages.subject: Re: Mentors please apply at melange
parts:
I forgot to say: when you apply, please say shortly who you are and what
your project is as we don't yet know all of you (other organisations
were complaining about "spam" mentor applications).

Thx Claudia
